name: orchestrate
description: Coordinate staged or parallel jobs across live-verified coding-agent runtimes, coding-agent sessions, and in-session subagents through one runtime-adapter contract and a normalized event protocol, routed by deterministic capability- and risk-based policy with an optional provider-neutral System-1 decision plane for trace watching, failure triage, and pre-arbiter gating. Worktree isolation, resumable state, capture, safety gates, and independent arbiter review included.
